name: intro
label::English (en): **Lakeside Community Health Check** (fictional sample form). Staff complete this form with the participant. Choose the visit first.

name: participant_id
constraint_message::English (en): Use the format LH-0000: LH, a dash, then 4 digits.

name: scr_date
constraint_message::English (en): The date cannot be before 2026 or in the future.

name: consent
label::English (en): Has the participant signed the study consent form?

name: consent_stop
label::English (en): **STOP.** Do not continue: people can only take part after signing the consent form.

name: dob
label::English (en): 1. What is your date of birth?
constraint_message::English (en): The date cannot be before 1900 or in the future.

name: age_stop
label::English (en): **STOP.** This person is under 18 and cannot take part. Do not continue.

name: education
label::English (en): 3. What is the highest level of education you have completed?

name: household
label::English (en): 4. How many people live in your household, including you?
constraint_message::English (en): Enter a number from 1 to 20.

name: conditions
label::English (en): 5. Has a doctor or nurse ever told you that you have any of these conditions? Tick all that apply.
constraint_message::English (en): 'None of these' cannot be ticked together with a condition.

name: bp_med
label::English (en): 6. Are you currently taking medicine for high blood pressure?

name: smoke_status
label::English (en): 7. Do you smoke tobacco (cigarettes, cigars, pipe, water-pipe or similar)?

name: cig_per_day
label::English (en): 8. On a day when you smoke, how many cigarettes (or similar) do you usually smoke?
constraint_message::English (en): Enter a number from 1 to 80.

name: active_days
label::English (en): 9. In a usual week, on how many days are you active for at least 30 minutes (for example brisk walking, cycling, sport or heavy housework)?
constraint_message::English (en): Enter a number from 0 to 7.

name: fruit_veg
label::English (en): 10. On a usual day, how many portions of fruit and vegetables do you eat? One portion is about a handful.
constraint_message::English (en): Enter a number from 0 to 20.

name: energy
label::English (en): 11. Over the past week, how much energy have you had?
hint::English (en): 0 = No energy at all, 100 = Full of energy

name: sleep_trouble
label::English (en): 12. Over the past month, how often have you had trouble sleeping?

name: scr_symptoms
label::English (en): 13. In the past 2 weeks, how often have you had the following?

name: height_cm
hint::English (en): Measure without shoes. Enter one decimal place, e.g. 165.0
constraint_message::English (en): Enter a height from 100 to 230 cm.

name: weight_kg
hint::English (en): Light clothing, no shoes. Enter one decimal place, e.g. 72.4
constraint_message::English (en): Enter a weight from 30 to 250 kg.

name: bmi
calculation: if(${height_cm} != '' and ${weight_kg} != '', round(${weight_kg} div ((${height_cm} div 100) * (${height_cm} div 100)), 1), '')

name: scr_sbp
constraint_message::English (en): Enter a value from 70 to 250.

name: scr_dbp
constraint_message::English (en): Enter a value from 40 to 150, lower than the systolic value.

name: section_d
label::English (en): Section D: Result and follow-up (staff to complete)

name: bp_high_msg
label::English (en): This reading is 140/90 mmHg or higher. Give the participant the advice leaflet and invite them to the 3 follow-up visits.

name: fu_agree
label::English (en): Has the participant agreed to the 3 follow-up visits?

name: contact_intro
label::English (en): Complete this form only if the participant agreed to the follow-up visits. These details identify the participant: record them only here.

name: contact_sms
label::English (en): May we send text message reminders before each visit?

name: scr_notes
label::English (en): Staff notes (do not write names, addresses or phone numbers here)
constraint_message::English (en): Keep notes under 500 characters.

name: fu_date
label::English (en): F1. Date of visit (or date of last contact attempt)
constraint_message::English (en): The date cannot be before 2026 or in the future.

name: fu_attended
label::English (en): F2. Did the visit take place?

name: fu_missed_reason
label::English (en): F3. Main reason the visit did not take place

name: fu_sbp
constraint_message::English (en): Enter a value from 70 to 250.

name: fu_dbp
constraint_message::English (en): Enter a value from 40 to 150, lower than the systolic value.

name: fu_weight
hint::English (en): Light clothing, no shoes. Enter one decimal place, e.g. 72.4
constraint_message::English (en): Enter a weight from 30 to 250 kg.

name: fu_bp_med
label::English (en): F6. Are you currently taking medicine for high blood pressure?

name: fu_med_days
label::English (en): F7. On how many of the last 7 days did you take your blood pressure medicine?
constraint_message::English (en): Enter a number from 0 to 7.

name: fu_symptoms
label::English (en): F8. In the past 2 weeks, how often have you had the following?

name: fu_health_event
label::English (en): F9. Since the last visit, have you stayed overnight in hospital, visited an emergency department, or been told you have a new health condition?

name: fu_he_msg
label::English (en): Complete one Health event form for each event.

name: he_date
constraint_message::English (en): The date cannot be before 2026 or in the future.

name: he_nights
label::English (en): H3. Number of nights in hospital
constraint_message::English (en): Enter a number from 1 to 365.

name: he_heart
label::English (en): H4. Was the event related to the heart or blood pressure?

name: he_desc
label::English (en): H5. Brief description (no names or other identifying details)
constraint_message::English (en): Keep the description under 500 characters.

name: fu_notes
label::English (en): Staff notes (do not write names, addresses or phone numbers here)
constraint_message::English (en): Keep notes under 500 characters.
